title: Tier frontier: supplied bandwidth per GB stored, relative $/GB and idle latency

units.energy_pj_bit: pJ/bit, with energy_scope (report only, not plotted)

conventions: All bandwidths are peak, per direction, from vendor specs unless a row says measured. Capacities are the stated device/rack capacity. GB means 10^9 bytes and TB = 1000 GB throughout (spec arithmetic). Raptor is vendor peak, plotted hollow. Ranges are config-dependent as stated per row.

extraction.method: Re-read HC'26 deck texts (AMD sys, Rubin, Vera, DMR, d-Matrix, LP30), Xeon Max arXiv 2505.14294 p.1 (pdftotext), and notes/synthesis for the non-HC rows; arithmetic recomputed in Python (scratchpad mk_e5.py).

cross_check.max_disagreement: none on derived values (both: A64FX 31.25 not 32; CXL low 0.0625)
cross_check.resolved: Vistara 0.225 relabelled spec-based (Table V), not measured; RDMA 0.01-0.1 range is an assumption-based [D] (12.5 GB/s NIC over 128 GB-1 TB) with no printed source

caveats: d-Matrix s13 capacity and bandwidth come from the vision-model description of the slide image, not the PDF text layer (title only). Image not independently viewed by extractor A.

Vistara ISCA'26 and the NVIDIA B200/GH200/GB200 specs are not stored in fulltext/; values are taken from notes/SYNTHESIS (FLAG G7). Vistara figures were read in full online by earlier rounds per notes.
A64FX 1 TB/s / 32 GB is [S]. Stored as 31.25; BRIEF shows 32 (matches 1.024 TB/s).
DMR 1/2/4 TB capacities are our 16 x 64/128/256 GB DIMM assumption, not printed on slides.
RDMA 0.01-0.1 range and NVMe specs are inherited from synthesis/notes and were not re-derived from primary configs.
Rubin 72.7 is fleet-level and depends on a footnoted 'MaxLPS' configuration.
Energy fields are for the report only and must not be compared across scopes; the slide shows no energy.
